email.description: The join key between systems. A person in the company's records and a user in the card platform are the same person when their emails match.
email.title: Email

manager_id.description: Person.id of their manager. The card platform's value is used live.
manager_id.title: Manager Id

platform_role.description: Permission level in the card platform, e.g. Ramp's BUSINESS_ADMIN.
platform_role.title: Platform Role

role.description: Job role, e.g. 'cfo'. Approval rules match on it. It comes from the company's own records, never from the card platform's permission levels.
role.title: Role
